name: Crabman

tactics.harder: Focus weaker targets with the Crabman's friends while melee fighters are grappled.

name: Crabman Brute
flavor: Crustacean warriors that love a good scrap. Their massive bulk and natural armor demands constant meat as fuel. Embroiled in constant struggles for control of beaches, bogs and caves.

tactics.easier: Start an argument about which Crabman is strongest! Alternatively, push a grappled hero out of a Crabman's grasp.
tactics.harder: Push heroes into deep water, sharp stones, or other hazards.

name: Huskwalker
flavor: Crabmen reanimated by necromantic meddling. Sometimes they wash up on shore, mindlessly terrorizing anyone nearby.

tactics.easier: Attack any target that is closest. Move on to other targets after knocking Prone, or wander aimlessly is a undead haze.
tactics.harder: Crabmen can dog-pile a hero knocked prone by a Huskwalker, keeping them pinned with Grapple.

actions.text: Fly 8 into the air. Next turn deal 2d12+10 to a 4x4 area, then land knocking adjacent enemies Prone.

bloodied.name: Immolate!
bloodied.text: At 90 HP: (Reach 12, AoE) 2d12 to all enemies.

lastStand.text: At 0 HP, the Young Red Dragon is dying! 60 more damage and it dies! Until then, it is Enraged. Lose Medium armor, roll d20s instead of d12s.

tactics.easier: Dragons shouldn't be easy (but you could take an additional turn in the air "breathing in" and you can telegraph the area you'll be targeting).
tactics.harder: Take out your own whelps to enable Burninate! Combo Tail or Landing with Crush for big damage.

notes: Tactics are printed once after both Red Dragon blocks; copied to both.

name: Red Dragon

traits.name: Hatch Brood
traits.text: When Initiative is rolled, summon 2 Dragon Whelps/hero (minion size:d6)

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn choose 1 (recommended: in order)

actions.name: Immolating Breath
actions.text: Fly 10 into the air. Next turn choose a 6x6 area for 2d20+10 damage, then land knocking adjacent enemies Prone.

actions.name: BURNINATE!
actions.text: (If all Dragon Whelps are destroyed; 1 use) (Reach 30 AoE) 2d20+20.

bloodied.name: Fiery Doom Awaits!
bloodied.text: At 165 HP: Daze all enemies and end concentration. DC 17 WIL save or Frightened as well; fail by 10 or more, Dying.

lastStand.text: At 0 HP, the Red Dragon is dying! 120 more damage and it dies! Lose Medium armor. Recharge BURNINATE!

tactics.easier: Dragons shouldn't be easy (but you could take an additional turn in the air "breathing in" and you can telegraph the area you'll be targeting).
tactics.harder: Take out your own whelps to enable Burninate! Combo Tail or Landing with Crush for big damage.

notes: Actions printed under the label 'Actions:'. Tactics are printed once after both Red Dragon blocks; copied to both.

actions.name: Fire!
actions.text: (Cone 4) 4d8. Must spend an attack to reload after firing.

tactics.easier: Start combat needing to reload
tactics.harder: start combat loaded and ready to Fire!

traits.name: Blackguard
traits.text: You and adjacent allies reduce incoming damage by 5.

actions.name: Obey!
actions.text: (Reach 6) Strike an ally for 1d8, give them 1 action to use immediately.

tactics.easier: Use Obey! on allies that are already low on HP.
tactics.harder: Move the heroes into clumps to set up big AoE attacks from Blasthands. And whip Blasthands to make them reload faster.

name: Brimstone Scorchsmith

traits.name: Flame Forged
traits.text: When damaged, adjacent creatures take 5 fire damage.

tactics.easier: Place allies adjacent to be damaged by Flame Forged.
tactics.harder: Combine with a Blackguard to protect allies from their damage. Whip them for tremendous fire damage when surrounded by heroes.

notes: Block continues at the top of the next column.

traits.name: Pyretic End
traits.text: On death (Reach 3): 2d20 fire damage, Summon a Fire Elemental.

tactics.easier: The fire elemental trapped within sees the heroes as its ally against the Dwarves.
tactics.harder: The fire elemental attacks the heroes.

name: Iron Golem

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.text: Immune to being Hampered. Ignore any damage less than 10, reduce all damage taken to 10.

actions.name: Iron Grip
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d20, Grapple (escape DC 20). +1d20 for each round Grappled. Then:

bloodied.name: Mighty Leap
bloodied.text: (50hp) Immediately leap 12, knock creatures adjacent to where you land Prone. (1/round) You can use Iron Grip as a reaction when a creature would enter or leave your Reach.

notes: Flavor is an 'xx' placeholder; no tactics printed.

name: Forge Tyrant Drunzir
kind: Brimstone Smith and his Manticore Mount
actionsIntro: Mounted Combatant: After each hero's turn choose 1:

bloodied.name: Intimidating Roar
bloodied.text: (100 hp) Heroes cannot move this round on a failed DC 15 WIL save.

lastStand.text: At 0hp Drunzir's mount is slain. He loses flying, and gains Heavy armor. He cleaves off the manticore's stinger to wield as his weapon. After each hero's turn choose 1. Cruel Whip. Move 5, then (Reach 6) 2d6+6. On hit: pull 6 and Restrain (escape DC 15). OR: Venomous Stinger. D66 (with advantage is Restrained).

flavor: As sturdy and hot-tempered as the caverns that forged him. Among the harsh clanging of hammers, screech of chains, and blasts of steam, Drunzir rules his domain from the great forge under the mountains. All who dwell in the burghs of brimstone fear his cruelty.
notes: Printed as 'Venomous Stinger (Reach 2). d66'. Tactics are 'xx' placeholders.

name: Iron Goat

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.text: Cannot be moved against its will except by Large+ creatures.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text: 2d8. Knockback a number of spaces equal to the distance moved toward the target.

flavor: Their primary mode of dealing with predators (or heroes) is to knock them off a steep cliff.

tactics.easier: Knock heroes straight back and chase them down.
tactics.harder: Knock heroes off cliffs or into rocks for extra forced movement damage. Make them climb back up to reach you, then do it again!

name: Ice Troll

traits.name: Regenerate
traits.text: Does not die at 0 HP. Only fire, radiant, or a crit while at 0 HP can kill it.

flavor: Known for their brutality and ravenous appetites, there is a long-running debate among scholars about whether Trolls are a type of giant Goblin, or a goblinesque Giant.

name: Young Remorhaz

traits.name: Ambush Predator
traits.text: Acts before vs lower level heroes

traits.name: Living Blast Furnace
traits.text: (1/round) Creatures who come within Reach 1 suffer 1d10 fire damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: (VS Grappled creature) Swallowed: D44 damage at the beginning of your turn, your attacks ignore armor.

flavor: Remorhaz develop their hunting skills early, and leave the nest at a very young age. Although smaller, and with softer carapaces, a Young Remorhaz is a still a formidable threat.

tactics.easier: Focus on grappling, only Swallow when nearing death.
tactics.harder: Move often to apply Living Blast Furnace to all heroes each round. Swallow creatures who can easily ignore your armor anyway.

name: Remorhaz

traits.name: Ambush Predator
traits.text: Acts first.

traits.name: Living Blast Furnace
traits.text: (1/round) Creatures who come within Reach 1 suffer 2d10 fire damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: (VS Grappled creature) Swallowed: D88 damage at the beginning of your turn, your attacks ignore armor.

flavor: A crested, centipede-like terror of the wastes. Remorhaz can spit blue flame, melting tunnels in the otherwise permanent ice at the edges of the world.

name: Yeti
flavor: Not just accustomed to the cold, Yetis live and breathe ice. Great bear-like brutes, they are found inhabiting caves on remote and forbidding mountain peaks, and do not welcome visitors.

name: Abominable Yeti

actions.name: Dreadful Eye
actions.text: (Reach 12) 30 damage – WIL save; 10 or less, cannot move next turn.

actions.name: Limb from Limb
actions.text: (vs a creature that crit you this round). 2d20+20, Grapple. If this drops them to 0 hp, target loses a limb (their choice: disadvantage on attacks or half speed until mended)—can be mended by spending 10hp worth of magical healing).

bloodied.text: At 90hp gain Frost breath. (1 use, Cone 5) 2d20+20, Slowed.

flavor: Yetis can live for well over 100 hundred years, and are not fully mature until near the end of that lifespan. Few have encountered a fully grown Yeti, and fewer yet returned to tell the tale.

tactics.easier: Use Dreadful Eye against close-range targets.
tactics.harder: Lock back heroes with big melee dice using Dreadful Eye. Punish Cheats and other crit-fishing heroes with Limb from Limb.
